title: 结构化请求的 Web—Native Bridge
summary: Web UI 与本机能力桥接时，前端提交受 schema/allowlist 约束的结构化任务，而不是任意 shell/FFmpeg 命令；bridge 只暴露最小能力并保持来源、文件和执行权限边界。
principles: The bridge accepts structured domain requests, not arbitrary command strings.
Native code constructs argument arrays and validates supported codecs/options.
Bridge-enabled WebView/content origin is restricted and remote navigation is blocked.
Native-selected content URI identity is retained by the native shell instead of reconstructed from browser File objects.
Local file paths and privileged management tokens are not exposed to untrusted page content.
Runtime capability is probed by the native side and returned as evidence.
